question: Where and how must arghya and related items be ritually purified in this instruction?
premises: Ritual action is directed to arghya and related items.
Those items are brought into an empty house setting.
Purification is prescribed as the required procedure there.
inference: One should bring arghya and related items into an empty house and then perform purification of them.
plain_english: Having brought arghya and the rest into an empty house, one should purify them.
